# pbs_roles (Data Source)

Lists the roles of a Proxmox Backup Server and the privileges each grants. The set of roles is fixed — PBS has no way to define others — and every user and API token may read it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_roles" "all" {}

locals {
  # The privileges each role grants, by role name.
  role_privileges = { for r in data.pbs_roles.all.roles : r.roleid => r.privileges }
}

# The roles that let an API token back up to a datastore.
output "backup_roles" {
  value = [for name, privileges in local.role_privileges : name if contains(privileges, "Datastore.Backup")]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Attributes List) The roles, in the order PBS lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) PBS's description of the role; null when there is none.
- `privileges` (List of String) Privileges the role grants, such as `Datastore.Backup`.
- `roleid` (String) Name of the role, such as `DatastoreBackup`: the `role` of a `pbs_acl`.
